hypotheses.title: 5-Day Smoothed Delta & 180-Day Consensus Cash Flow Yield
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Optimizes Candidate 2 from Batch 62 (Sharpe 1.27, Fitness 0.97) by tightening the fundamental lookback from 252 to 180 days and extending delta lookback from 3 to 5 days with lower 10% weight to curb turnover and push Fitness into the GOOD tier.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if 5-day delta exhibits strong momentum persistence instead of mean reversion.

candidates.rationale: 180-Day Cash Flow Yield with 5-Day Smoothed Reversion

hypotheses.title: Market-Neutralized 180-Day Consensus Cash Flow Yield
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Expands cash flow yield ranking to whole-market scope, capturing cross-industry relative value while maintaining zero market beta. Drives both Fitness and Uniqueness higher.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if structural sector shifts overwhelm market-wide cash flow yields.

candidates.rationale: Market-Neutral 180-Day Cash Flow Yield with 5-Day Reversion

hypotheses.title: Consensus Cash Flow Yield & Operational Cashflow Efficiency Multi-Dataset Synergy
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Firms with high forward analyst cash flow yield (anl4_afv4_cfps_median / close) paired with top operational cash generation efficiency per unit of capital (cashflow_efficiency_rank_derivative) combine sell-side optimism with balance-sheet verification. 100% instrument coverage boosts Sharpe and compresses turnover.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if cash generation efficiency deteriorates amid rising inventory accumulation.

candidates.rationale: Forward Consensus CFPS Yield & Operational Cash Efficiency Synergy
